mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, t.province_id AS provinceId, t.city_id AS cityId, t.county_id AS countyId, t.town_code as townCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t d INNER JOIN vm_order_devices o ON o.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and o.industry_code = d.industry_code and o.device_code = d.device_code INNER JOIN vm_device_info_t t ON d.device_code = t.device_code WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.device_type = 4 AND t.delete_flag = '0' AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND o.ord_status in (0,1,2) GROUP BY d.dept_id, t.province_id, t.city_id, t.county_id, t.town_code UNION SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, it.province_id AS provinceId, it.city_id AS cityId, it.county_id AS countyId, it.town_code as townCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t d INNER JOIN vm_order_sensor_devices o ON o.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and o.industry_code = d.industry_code and o.device_code = d.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t it ON d.device_code = it.device_code WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.device_type in (8, 10) AND it.delete_flag = '0' AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND o.ord_status in (0,1,2) GROUP BY d.dept_id, it.province_id, it.city_id, it.county_id, it.town_code UNION
